about_the_game:
In this free demo. Get ready for an explosive blend of moonshine, espionage, and tropical chaos — now with CO-OP (Full version)!

In MULERUN, you’re not just any outlaw. You’re a legendary moonshiner caught by the CIA and faced with a choice: rot in prison for 15 years… or run risky missions for the government while building your own black market booze empire.

🌴 From brewing shady cocktails in your jungle shack to flying covert ops over cartel territory, every day brings new challenges, new risks, and new rewards.

WHAT'S INCLUDED IN THE DEMO

✅ Character Customization

  • Create your own outlaw with various skin tones, hairstyles, clothes, and accessories.

✅ Base Setup

  • Start in your simple house and discover your family’s legendary bootlegging recipe book.

✅ Brewing System

  • Experience the basic alcohol brewing process with beginner tools.

  • Harvest basic ingredients like apples and coconuts.

  • Bottle, cap, and sell your first drinks at the nightclub.

✅ First Missions

  • Get recruited by the CIA.

  • Complete your first aerial photography mission using a beat-up plane.

  • Avoid detection with stealth mechanics like radar evasion and low-altitude flight.

✅ Open World Exploration

  • Explore your local area.

  • Interact with NPCs.

  • Visit the general store and collect ingredients.

✅ Mini-games & Bars

  • Try out early mini-games and arcade machines.

  • Sell alcohol to Jack at the club.

✅ Day/Night Cycle & XP System

  • Experience time-based events and level up your character.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3GHz 4-Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3.5GHz 6-Core or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 or Radeon RX 6700
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: Start solo or in online co-op, with each player taking on different roles: brew master, getaway driver, shady negotiator, or air support pilot. You’ll need to cooperate (or yell at each other) as you dodge cops, complete ridiculous tasks, and climb the ranks of two very dangerous worlds...
